name: Maldives

findings.summary: Dhiraagu launched the first commercial 5G service in the Maldives and South Asia in selected areas of Malé, Hulhumalé, the airport, Addu City and Kulhudhuffushi, with Huawei supplying the equipment and implementation services.
findings.analyst_inference: Total Telecom reproduces Dhiraagu's own release, and TelecomTV confirms the launch but does not name the network vendor, so the Huawei award is not independently corroborated; single opened S1 permits medium. Tier 4 rather than 5 because coverage was limited to selected locations at launch. Whether Huawei also supplies Dhiraagu's 4G RAN/core is not established.

findings.summary: Ooredoo Group chose Huawei to supply 5G SingleRAN radio and 5G cloud core equipment over five years in five markets, including the Maldives, to modernise its existing mobile networks.
findings.analyst_inference: Both reports appear to derive from the same Huawei announcement (vendor marketing), so not treated as independent; uncorroborated tier 3, low. Group-level sourcing deal; no Maldives-specific award notice or value. Ooredoo Maldives' parent is Qatar's Ooredoo, but the equipment-vendor rule makes this prc.

findings.local_actor: Dhiraagu; Ooredoo Maldives; Dialog Axiata (Sri Lanka) consortium
findings.summary: HMN Tech built the 840 km, four-fibre-pair Maldives Sri Lanka Cable (MSC) from Hulhumalé to Mount Lavinia for a Dhiraagu, Ooredoo Maldives and Dialog Axiata consortium; the contract was announced February 2020 and completion reported February 2021.
findings.analyst_inference: Two independent S2 outlets covering the award (HMN release) and completion (Dialog release). Tier 4: system completion reported, ready-for-service date not confirmed in opened sources. Equipment vendor sets pole prc. Value not disclosed.

findings.summary: Ooredoo Maldives inaugurated its 1,200 km national submarine cable linking six main islands, built by Huawei Marine using 100G technology with 3.2 Tbps design capacity.
findings.analyst_inference: Capacity covers only the earlier partnership announcement (undated on page), so it does not corroborate the inauguration; uncorroborated tier 5, low. Pre-2020 and current operating status not checked, so still_current null (map halves it). Value not disclosed.

findings.local_actor: Communications Authority of Maldives; Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology
findings.summary: The Communications Authority of Maldives issued an ISP licence to Starlink Services Maldives, a SpaceX-incorporated company, making it the country's fourth licensed ISP for nationwide satellite internet including outer islands and vessels.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 4: licence issued. A later service-launch report (Adhadhu) appeared in search results but was not opened, so tier 5 not coded; subscriber scale unknown.

findings.local_actor: Government of Maldives (President's Office); Dhiraagu; Ooredoo Maldives
findings.summary: The President's Office announced Google's decision to invest in an international cable landing station and network hub at Hithadhoo, Addu City, part of Google's Dhivaru cable linking Oman, the Maldives and Christmas Island, with local operators as partners.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 1: an announced investment decision; no signed instrument, timeline or capacity disclosed. 'Tens of millions of dollars' too vague to record as a value. Adhadhu reports opposition MDP criticism and questions over ownership of the station; not a reversal.

findings.summary: Dhiraagu opened a Hulhumalé data centre it describes as the Maldives' first Uptime Institute Tier IV certified facility, inaugurated by the Minister of Homeland Security and Technology.
findings.analyst_inference: Single opened S3 source; uncorroborated, low. Owner-operator Dhiraagu is Maldives-incorporated, so domestic; its shareholding (widely reported as majority Batelco, Bahrain) was not verified in opened sources and could make it third. Equipment vendors and AI use not stated.

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchases surfaced in other searches
